<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>LIV.U — The recovery platform built for competitive soccer.</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Know when to push. Know when to protect. The first recovery intelligence platform built specifically for competitive soccer players aged 14–30."/>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin/>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,200;0,9..144,300;1,9..144,200;1,9..144,300&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
  <style>
    *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    :root{background:#06091A;}
    html,body{background:#06091A !important;min-height:100%;overflow-x:hidden;
      color:#F0EDE8;font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,sans-serif;
      -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;color-scheme:dark;}
    a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit;}

    @keyframes breathe{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.04)}}
    @keyframes glow-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.55}50%{opacity:.85}}
    @keyframes fade-rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

    .fade{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);
      transition:opacity .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);}
    .fade.in{opacity:1;transform:none;}
    .d1{transition-delay:.10s}.d2{transition-delay:.20s}.d3{transition-delay:.30s}.d4{transition-delay:.40s}

    /* ── NAV ── */
    #nav{
      position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:300;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
      padding:17px 36px;background:#06091A;
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,0.08);
      transition:backdrop-filter .3s;
    }
    #nav.blur{backdrop-filter:blur(24px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px);background:rgba(6,9,26,.94);}
    .nav-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
    .nav-crest{width:20px;height:auto;filter:invert(1) brightness(2);opacity:0.82;}
    .nav-logo{font-family:'Inter';font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.44em;text-transform:uppercase;}
    .nav-r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
    .nav-link{font-family:'Inter';font-size:11px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(240,237,232,.52);transition:color .2s;}
    .nav-link:hover{color:#F0EDE8;}
    .nav-demo{
      font-family:'Inter';font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
      padding:10px 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#2979FF;color:#06091A;
      transition:opacity .2s,transform .15s;
    }
    .nav-demo:hover{opacity:.88;transform:translateY(-1px);}
    .menu-btn{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:4px;}
    .menu-btn span{display:block;width:22px;height:1.5px;background:#F0EDE8;}

    .overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:400;background:#06091A;
      transform:translateY(-100%);visibility:hidden;
      transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),visibility .45s;
      display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
    .overlay.open{transform:none;visibility:visible;}
    .ov-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:17px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);}
    .ov-close{font-size:26px;font-weight:200;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:#F0EDE8;line-height:1;}
    .ov-links a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:20px 24px;
      font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:200;font-style:italic;
      color:#F0EDE8;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);transition:color .2s,padding-left .2s;}
    .ov-links a:hover{color:#2979FF;padding-left:32px;}
    .ov-cta{padding:20px 24px;}
    .ov-cta a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:12px;background:#2979FF;color:#06091A;font-family:'Inter';font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;}

    /* ── LAYOUT ── */
    .wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 36px;}
    .pad{padding:96px 0;}
    .border-t{border-top:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,0.10);}
    .eyebrow{font-family:'Inter';font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.30em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(240,237,232,.40);margin-bottom:14px;}
    .eyebrow.blue{color:#2979FF;} .eyebrow.green{color:#00E676;}
    h2.serif{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(26px,3.8vw,46px);font-weight:200;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.12;color:#F0EDE8;}

    /* ════════════════════════
       HERO
    ════════════════════════ */
    #hero{
      min-height:100vh;background:#06091A;
      display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      text-align:center;padding:130px 36px 72px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    }
    .hero-glow{
      position:absolute;top:45%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
      width:640px;height:640px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(41,121,255,.07) 0%,transparent 65%);
      animation:glow-pulse 12s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .crest-bg{
      position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-52%);
      width:min(50vw,380px);opacity:.055;pointer-events:none;
      filter:invert(1) brightness(2);
    }
    /* Orb */
    .orb-wrap{
      position:relative;width:180px;height:180px;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      margin-bottom:28px;z-index:2;
    }
    .orb-ring{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.06);}
    .orb-ring-2{position:absolute;inset:18px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.04);}
    .orb-glow{
      position:absolute;inset:26px;border-radius:50%;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,230,118,.24) 0%,rgba(0,230,118,.07) 48%,transparent 72%);
      filter:blur(8px);transition:background 2s ease;
      animation:glow-pulse 8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .orb-core{
      position:relative;z-index:2;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      animation:breathe 10s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .orb-state{
      font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:200;
      font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#00E676;
      transition:color 1.8s ease,opacity .4s ease;
    }
    /* Hero text */
    .hero-kicker{
      font-family:'Inter';font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.30em;
      text-transform:uppercase;color:#2979FF;
      margin-bottom:14px;z-index:2;position:relative;
    }
    .hero-h1{
      font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;
      font-size:clamp(36px,6vw,68px);font-weight:200;font-style:italic;
      letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.06;color:#F0EDE8;
      margin-bottom:10px;z-index:2;position:relative;
    }
    .hero-h1 .accent{font-style:normal;font-weight:300;color:#2979FF;}
    .hero-rule{
      font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,30px);
      font-weight:200;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-.025em;
      color:rgba(240,237,232,.38);margin-bottom:28px;z-index:2;position:relative;
    }
    .hero-rule em{font-style:normal;color:#2979FF;}
    .hero-sub{
      font-family:'Inter';font-size:16px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.72;
      color:rgba(240,237,232,.72);max-width:480px;margin:0 auto 30px;
      z-index:2;position:relative;
    }
    .trust{
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;
      font-family:'Inter';font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;
      text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(240,237,232,.34);
      margin-bottom:36px;z-index:2;position:relative;
    }
    .tdot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#00E676;box-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(0,230,118,.5);}
    .hero-btns{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;z-index:2;position:relative;}
    .btn-p{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:13px 30px;border-radius:12px;background:#2979FF;color:#06091A;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter';font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:opacity .2s,transform .15s;box-shadow:0 8px 28px -8px rgba(41,121,255,.45);}
    .btn-p:hover{opacity:.88;transform:translateY(-1px);}
    .btn-g{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:13px 24px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.22);color:rgba(240,237,232,.85);background:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter';font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:border-color .2s,color .2s;}
    .btn-g:hover{border-color:rgba(240,237,232,.40);color:#F0EDE8;}

    /* Score cards */
    .score-row{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:44px;z-index:2;position:relative;}
    .sc{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.10);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:120px;}
    .sc-arc{position:relative;width:56px;height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
    .sc-arc svg{position:absolute;inset:0;transform:rotate(-90deg);}
    .sc-n{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:200;letter-spacing:-.04em;position:relative;z-index:1;}
    .sc-state{font-family:'Inter';font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.20em;text-transform:uppercase;}
    .sc-verb{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:200;font-style:italic;}
    .sc-pos{font-family:'Inter';font-size:8px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(240,237,232,.30);text-align:center;}

    /* ════════════════════════
       PROBLEM
    ════════════════════════ */
    #problem{padding:96px 0;background:#06091A;border-top:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);}
    .problem-quote{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(22px,3.2vw,36px);font-weight:200;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.45;color:rgba(240,237,232,.90);margin-bottom:22px;max-width:640px;}
    .problem-quote em{font-style:normal;color:#F0EDE8;font-weight:300;}
    .problem-body{font-family:'Inter';font-size:15px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.78;color:rgba(240,237,232,.62);border-left:2px solid rgba(240,237,232,.12);padding-left:20px;max-width:560px;}
    .problem-body strong{color:rgba(240,237,232,.90);font-weight:500;}

    /* Stats strip */
    .stat-strip{display:flex;gap:0;border:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.10);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:48px;}
    .stat-item{flex:1;padding:22px 20px;border-right:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.10);}
    .stat-item:last-child{border-right:none;}
    .stat-big{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:36px;font-weight:200;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:#2979FF;margin-bottom:4px;}
    .stat-label{font-family:'Inter';font-size:11px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(240,237,232,.60);line-height:1.55;}

    /* ════════════════════════
       PROOF — Comparison
    ════════════════════════ */
    #proof{padding:96px 0;background:#06091A;border-top:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);}
    .proof-context{max-width:580px;margin:0 auto 44px;text-align:center;font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:200;font-style:italic;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:rgba(240,237,232,.68);}
    .proof-context em{font-style:normal;color:#F0EDE8;}
    .cmp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;}
    .cc{border-radius:18px;padding:28px 22px;border:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.10);}
    .cc.win{border-color:rgba(41,121,255,.28);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(41,121,255,.10) 0%,rgba(41,121,255,.02) 100%);}
    .cc.flat{background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);opacity:.70;}
    .cc-tag{font-family:'Inter';font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px;}
    .cc.win .cc-tag{color:#2979FF;} .cc.flat .cc-tag{color:rgba(240,237,232,.35);}
    .cc-name{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:200;font-style:italic;color:#F0EDE8;margin-bottom:20px;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
    .cmp-row{padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);}
    .cmp-k{font-family:'Inter';font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.20em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(240,237,232,.40);margin-bottom:5px;}
    .cmp-v{font-family:'Inter';font-size:13px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.65;color:rgba(240,237,232,.85);}
    .cmp-v.dim{color:rgba(240,237,232,.42);font-style:italic;}
    .proof-verdict{text-align:center;margin-top:36px;font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(18px,2.8vw,26px);font-weight:200;font-style:italic;line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:rgba(240,237,232,.60);}
    .proof-verdict strong{font-style:normal;color:#2979FF;font-weight:300;}

    /* ════════════════════════
       HOW IT WORKS
    ════════════════════════ */
    #how{padding:96px 0;background:#06091A;border-top:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);}
    .how-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;}
    .hc{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.10);border-radius:16px;padding:24px 20px;}
    .hc-n{font-family:'Inter';font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.24em;color:#2979FF;margin-bottom:12px;}
    .hc h3{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:200;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:#F0EDE8;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:8px;}
    .hc p{font-family:'Inter';font-size:13px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.72;color:rgba(240,237,232,.75);}

    /* Soccer-specific signal */
    .soccer-signal{
      max-width:680px;margin:40px auto 0;
      background:rgba(0,230,118,.04);border:1px solid rgba(0,230,118,.18);
      border-radius:16px;padding:24px;
    }
    .ss-label{font-family:'Inter';font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#00E676;margin-bottom:14px;}
    .ss-positions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px;}
    .ss-pos{font-family:'Inter';font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(0,230,118,.22);color:rgba(0,230,118,.85);background:rgba(0,230,118,.06);}
    .ss-p{font-family:'Inter';font-size:13px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.72;color:rgba(240,237,232,.72);}

    /* ════════════════════════
       POSITION CARDS
    ════════════════════════ */
    #positions{padding:96px 0;background:#06091A;border-top:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);}
    .pos-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;}
    .pc-pos{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.10);border-radius:16px;padding:22px 18px;transition:border-color .3s,transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);}
    .pc-pos:hover{border-color:rgba(240,237,232,.22);transform:translateY(-3px);}
    .pc-pos-abbr{font-family:'Inter';font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#2979FF;margin-bottom:6px;}
    .pc-pos h4{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:200;font-style:italic;color:#F0EDE8;margin-bottom:8px;}
    .pc-pos p{font-family:'Inter';font-size:12px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.65;color:rgba(240,237,232,.68);}

    /* ════════════════════════
       RECRUITING HOOK
    ════════════════════════ */
    #recruiting{padding:96px 0;background:#06091A;border-top:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);}
    .rec-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:36px;align-items:center;}
    .rec-left h2{margin-bottom:16px;}
    .rec-left p{font-family:'Inter';font-size:15px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.78;color:rgba(240,237,232,.72);margin-bottom:14px;}
    .rec-card-ui{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.12);border-radius:18px;padding:24px;}
    .rec-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:18px;}
    .rec-name{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:200;font-style:italic;color:#F0EDE8;}
    .rec-badge{font-family:'Inter';font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#06091A;background:#00E676;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;}
    .rec-stats{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;}
    .rec-stat{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);font-family:'Inter';font-size:13px;}
    .rec-stat:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
    .rec-stat-k{color:rgba(240,237,232,.48);font-weight:300;}
    .rec-stat-v{font-weight:500;color:rgba(240,237,232,.95);}
    .rec-footer{margin-top:16px;font-family:'Inter';font-size:11px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(240,237,232,.40);font-style:italic;text-align:center;}

    /* ════════════════════════
       PRICING
    ════════════════════════ */
    #pricing{padding:96px 0;background:#06091A;border-top:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);}
    .price-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.35fr 1fr;gap:12px;}
    .pcard{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.10);border-radius:18px;padding:26px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;}
    .pcard.feat{border-color:rgba(41,121,255,.30);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(41,121,255,.10) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 100%);}
    .pbadge{position:absolute;top:-11px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:'Inter';font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;background:#2979FF;color:#06091A;padding:4px 14px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;}
    .ptier{font-family:'Inter';font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(240,237,232,.40);margin-bottom:10px;}
    .pprice{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:38px;font-weight:200;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:#F0EDE8;line-height:1;}
    .pper{font-family:'Inter';font-size:11px;font-weight:300;color:rgba(240,237,232,.40);margin-bottom:6px;}
    .pdesc{font-family:'Inter';font-size:12px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.65;color:rgba(240,237,232,.62);margin-bottom:16px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);}
    .pfeats{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;margin-bottom:20px;flex:1;}
    .pfeats li{font-family:'Inter';font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(240,237,232,.80);display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;}
    .pfeats li::before{content:'';width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#00E676;box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(0,230,118,.4);margin-top:6px;flex-shrink:0;}
    .pfeats li.dim{color:rgba(240,237,232,.30);}
    .pfeats li.dim::before{background:rgba(240,237,232,.14);box-shadow:none;}

    /* ════════════════════════
       FOUNDER
    ════════════════════════ */
    #why{padding:96px 0;background:#06091A;border-top:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);}
    .why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:36px;align-items:start;}
    .why-left p{font-family:'Inter';font-size:15px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.78;color:rgba(240,237,232,.72);margin-bottom:14px;}
    .why-accent{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:200;font-style:italic;color:#F0EDE8;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.5;margin-top:8px;}
    .founder-card{background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(41,121,255,.10) 0%,rgba(41,121,255,.02) 100%);border:1px solid rgba(41,121,255,.20);border-radius:18px;padding:28px 24px;}
    .founder-ey{font-family:'Inter';font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#2979FF;margin-bottom:16px;}
    .founder-q{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:200;font-style:italic;line-height:1.68;color:rgba(240,237,232,.88);margin-bottom:14px;letter-spacing:-.01em;}
    .founder-a{font-family:'Inter';font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#2979FF;}

    /* ════════════════════════
       FINAL CTA
    ════════════════════════ */
    #cta{padding:120px 0;background:#06091A;border-top:1px solid rgba(240,237,232,.08);text-align:center;}

<!-- ═══ PROBLEM ═══ -->
<section id="problem">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="fade">
      <p class="problem-quote">&ldquo;Every coach knows the feeling. A player looks <em>fine</em> at morning training. Then goes down in the second half — hamstring, adductor, gone.&rdquo;</p>
      <p class="problem-body">Not bad luck. <strong>Missing data.</strong> The cardiovascular signals that would have predicted it were there — in the overnight HRV, the sleep architecture, the post-match inflammatory load. They just weren&rsquo;t being read. LIV.U reads them. Every night. For every player.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-strip fade d1">
      <div class="stat-item">
        <div class="stat-big">67%</div>
        <div class="stat-label">of non-contact soccer injuries occur in the 48–72 hour post-match inflammatory window</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-item">
        <div class="stat-big">3.8M</div>
        <div class="stat-label">competitive soccer players in the US alone — none of them have position-specific recovery intelligence</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-item">
        <div class="stat-big">$0</div>
        <div class="stat-label">platforms purpose-built for competitive soccer recovery in the U14–U30 market. Until now.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ═══ HOW IT WORKS ═══ -->
<section id="how" class="border-t">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="fade" style="margin-bottom:44px;">
      <div class="eyebrow blue">The intelligence</div>
      <h2 class="serif fade d1">Built on cardiovascular data.<br>Tuned to your genetics.<br>Specific to your position.</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="how-grid">
      <div class="hc fade">
        <div class="hc-n">01 · Overnight reading</div>
        <h3>Your Apple Watch reads while you sleep.</h3>
        <p>HRV, resting heart rate, sleep stages, respiratory rate — captured continuously. By 6 AM the engine knows whether your nervous system absorbed yesterday or is still carrying it.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hc fade d1">
        <div class="hc-n">02 · Genetic calibration</div>
        <h3>Upload your 23andMe or AncestryDNA file. Once.</h3>
        <p>No new testing. A handful of well-studied markers tune your personal baseline — structural recovery speed, caffeine clearance, heat adaptation. Why your recovery curve isn&rsquo;t the same as your teammate&rsquo;s.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hc fade d2">
        <div class="hc-n">03 · Position-specific load</div>
        <h3>Center-backs and wingers aren&rsquo;t the same athlete.</h3>
        <p>The engine knows your position, your match calendar, and the physiological demands of your role. A CB&rsquo;s hamstring eccentric load after a high-sprint match is weighted differently than a winger&rsquo;s.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hc fade d3">
        <div class="hc-n">04 · One clear answer</div>
        <h3>Recovered. Balanced. Adapt. Every morning.</h3>
        <p>One state. One plain-English reason. No dashboard to navigate. The intelligence stays silent until it matters — then speaks once, clearly, before training begins.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="soccer-signal fade d3">
      <div class="ss-label">Soccer-specific intelligence · Post-match window</div>
      <div class="ss-positions">
        <span class="ss-pos">GK</span><span class="ss-pos">CB</span><span class="ss-pos">FB</span>
        <span class="ss-pos">CDM</span><span class="ss-pos">CM</span><span class="ss-pos">CAM</span>
        <span class="ss-pos">W</span><span class="ss-pos">ST</span>
      </div>
      <p class="ss-p">The 48–72 hour post-match inflammatory window is the highest injury-risk period in soccer. LIV.U tracks it by position — monitoring structural load, sprint volume, and cardiovascular recovery to flag when a player is in the danger zone before the next session begins.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ═══ POSITIONS ═══ -->
<section id="positions" class="border-t">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="fade" style="margin-bottom:44px;">
      <div class="eyebrow blue">Position Intelligence</div>
      <h2 class="serif fade d1">Your position shapes<br>every recommendation.</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="pos-grid">
      <div class="pc-pos fade">
        <div class="pc-pos-abbr">GK</div>
        <h4>Goalkeeper</h4>
        <p>Explosive short-burst demands, high psychological load on match day. Recovery weighted toward CNS restoration and reaction-time readiness.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pc-pos fade d1">
        <div class="pc-pos-abbr">CB</div>
        <h4>Center-back</h4>
        <p>High eccentric hamstring and adductor load from defensive duels and clearances. Post-match structural recovery is the primary flag.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pc-pos fade d2">
        <div class="pc-pos-abbr">FB / WB</div>
        <h4>Full-back & Wing-back</h4>
        <p>Highest running volume on the pitch. Aerobic cardiovascular load accumulates across a season — weekly trend monitoring is critical.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pc-pos fade">
        <div class="pc-pos-abbr">CM / CDM</div>
        <h4>Central Midfield</h4>
        <p>Combined physical and cognitive demand. Tactical decision fatigue compounds physical load — both dimensions tracked simultaneously.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pc-pos fade d1">
        <div class="pc-pos-abbr">W / AM</div>
        <h4>Winger & Attacking Mid</h4>
        <p>Sprint-intensive and change-of-direction dominant. Hamstring and hip flexor strain accumulates quickly in dense match schedules.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pc-pos fade d2">
        <div class="pc-pos-abbr">ST</div>
        <h4>Striker</h4>
        <p>Physical contact, aerial duels, and explosive acceleration. Recovery from blunt load and muscle soreness is the primary daily signal.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ═══ WHY US ═══ -->
<section id="why" class="border-t">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="why-grid">
      <div class="why-left fade">
        <div class="eyebrow blue" style="margin-bottom:14px;">Why LIV.U</div>
        <h2 class="serif" style="margin-bottom:16px;">WHOOP is generic.<br>Garmin is hardware.<br>Catapult costs $50,000.</h2>
        <p>There is nothing positioned between consumer wellness wearables and enterprise athletic performance systems for the competitive amateur soccer market. That gap is the company.</p>
        <p>LIV.U is software-first, athlete-owned, and built specifically for the demands of competitive soccer — the post-match inflammatory window, the sprint volume accumulation, the tournament stack, the recruiting showcase.</p>
        <p class="why-accent">Not a fitness tracker.<br>A recovery intelligence platform for soccer players who compete.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="founder-card fade d1">
        <div class="founder-ey">From the Founder</div>
        <p class="founder-q">&ldquo;I built LIV.U because I kept watching athletes break down in predictable, preventable ways. The data that would have protected them existed — in their wearables, in their calendars, in their DNA. Nobody was connecting it. Nobody was making it actionable for the athlete who trains four days a week and plays on weekends. That&rsquo;s the player LIV.U was built for.&rdquo;</p>
        <div class="founder-a">— Brian Lentz, MPAS, PA-C · University of Pennsylvania Cardiology</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
// Orb state rotation
var STATES=[
  {c:'#00E676',g:'rgba(0,230,118,0.24)',w:'Recovered'},
  {c:'#2979FF',g:'rgba(41,121,255,0.22)',w:'Balanced'},
  {c:'#D500F9',g:'rgba(213,0,249,0.20)',w:'Adapt'}
];
var si=0;
function rotateOrb(){
  var s=STATES[si%STATES.length];
  var g=document.getElementById('orb-glow');
  var w=document.getElementById('orb-state');
  if(g) g.style.background='radial-gradient(circle,'+s.g+' 0%,rgba('+s.g.match(/[\d.]+/g).slice(0,3).join(',')+',.07) 48%,transparent 72%)';
  if(w){w.style.opacity='0';setTimeout(function(){w.textContent=s.w;w.style.color=s.c;w.style.opacity='1';},350);}
  si++;
}
rotateOrb();
setInterval(rotateOrb,3500);

// Nav
window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){document.getElementById('nav').classList.toggle('blur',window.scrollY>20);},{passive:true});
function openMenu(){document.getElementById('ov').classList.add('open');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';}
function closeMenu(){document.getElementById('ov').classList.remove('open');document.body.style.overflow='';}
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')closeMenu();});

// Scroll fade
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
  es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target);}}); 
},{threshold:0.07,rootMargin:'0px 0px -30px 0px'});
document.querySelectorAll('.fade').forEach(function(el){io.observe(el);});

// Arc fills
var ao=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
  es.forEach(function(e){
    if(e.isIntersecting){
      e.target.querySelectorAll('.arc-c').forEach(function(c){
        var s=parseInt(c.dataset.s||0),circ=150.8,off=circ-(s/100)*circ;
        c.style.strokeDashoffset=off;
      });
      ao.unobserve(e.target);
    }
  });
},{threshold:0.3});
var sr=document.querySelector('.score-row');if(sr)ao.observe(sr);
</script>
